Hayward Workers’ Compensation Lawyer: Your Local Experts for Workplace Injury Claims

If you’ve been injured on the job in Hayward, California, you deserve a legal team that understands the unique needs of local workers and the community. At Franco Muñoz Law Firm, we’re proud to expand our services to Hayward, bringing years of experience and a proven track record in workers’ compensation law right to your doorstep. Our deep roots in the Bay Area mean we know Hayward well, from the local industries to the WCAB office in nearby Oakland.

Why Choose Franco Muñoz Law Firm in Hayward?

Our Hayward office offers the same dedication, experience, and personalized service that have made us a top choice for injured workers throughout the Bay Area. Here’s why Hayward residents trust us with their workers’ compensation cases:

  • Local Knowledge: We’re familiar with the unique aspects of Hayward’s diverse economy, from the industrial and logistics sectors along the Hayward Shoreline to the retail hubs at Southland Mall.
  • Decades of Experience: We have handled thousands of cases throughout the Bay Area, securing millions in settlements and benefits for our clients.
  • No Fees Unless We Win: We work on a contingency basis, so you don’t pay any legal fees unless we secure benefits or a settlement for you.

HOW IT WORKS

Franco Muñoz Law, California's premier workers’ compensation attorneys, simplify the process like 1-2-3.

 
1

Get a Free Injury Case Result.

Consultations: Free & Confidential. Call us right after your accident for a complimentary 24/7 no-obligation case evaluation with one of our Injury Lawyers.

2

Provide Details About Your Injury Case.

We'll ask for all the details about your case. Then, we'll decide if you have a valid case & figure out the best plan for you.

3

Keep Our Services Without Paying Anything Upfront.

After our lawyers thoroughly review your case, our office will act as your dedicated point of contact, ensuring your case achieves the best possible outcome.

4

Start Receiving Eligible Medical and Monetary Benefits.

We'll fight for your medical treatment, lost wages, and compensation.

Types of Workers’ Compensation Benefits Available to Hayward Workers

California law provides several types of benefits for injured workers, and our team will fight to ensure you get everything you’re entitled to:

  • Medical Treatment: Full coverage for necessary medical care, including doctor visits, surgeries, medications, and therapy.
  • Temporary Disability Benefits: Payments to cover lost wages if you’re unable to work while recovering from your injury.
  • Permanent Disability Benefits: Compensation if your injury leads to a lasting impairment that affects your ability to work.
  • Supplemental Job Displacement Benefits: Vouchers for retraining if you can’t return to your previous job.
  • Death Benefits: Financial support for the dependents of a worker who has died as a result of a work-related injury or illness.

Common Workplace Injuries in Hayward

Hayward’s workforce is diverse, including roles in manufacturing, retail, transportation, and healthcare. Our attorneys have extensive experience handling claims for a variety of injuries common to the local area:

  • Warehouse and Logistics Injuries: With Hayward’s strong presence in the logistics industry, we frequently handle claims for back strains, forklift accidents, and repetitive stress injuries.
  • Construction Accidents: Including falls from scaffolding, equipment malfunctions, and injuries from heavy machinery.
  • Retail Injuries: Slip-and-fall accidents, lifting injuries, and repetitive strain injuries are common among retail workers at places like Southland Mall and Costco.
  • Healthcare Worker Injuries: Back strains from patient lifting, needlestick injuries, and exposure to contagious diseases.
  • Transportation Accidents: Including vehicle collisions for delivery drivers and truckers navigating Hayward’s busy I-880 corridor.

What Our Clients Say About Us

  • Steve was fantastic! His initial estimate on any potential settlement was exceeded through his skill, professionalism and trusted relationship with fellow litigators. He and his assistant Ms. Santiago explained things admirably and dealt with all of my questions and concerns in a timely and effective manor. Thank you so much to both of you for your support and effectiveness through this difficult time.

    - Brian

  • Mr. Steve Franco has been my attorney for the past seven years. He is reliable, professional, sincere and exceptionally best at what he does. I feel extremely fortunate to have found him to represent me. I trust him with utmost confidence in all of his advice and so far the end results have well exceeded my expectations! What separates him from the rest of them out there is that he truly enjoys his work.

    - John

  • I was injured at work and was tired of "insurance company doctors" that just wanted to prescribe medication and send me on my way. My medical care improved significantly with the help of Mr. Franco. He communicated complex issues in terms I could understand... And when the case was done I was only charged a very fair fee. If you need help navigating through legal matters I really suggest you give Mr. Franco a call. He's a top notch attorney.

    - Chris

Schedule Your Free Consultation Today

We understand that dealing with a workplace injury can be stressful, especially when you’re facing medical bills and lost wages. That’s why we offer a free, no-obligation consultation to help you understand your rights and next steps. Contact our office today and let us fight for the benefits you deserve.

Call us at (510) 257-4141 or use the contact form below to schedule your consultation. We’re here to help you get back on your feet.
